lessons.finding: The documented async=true option returns messageId immediately. Request it to avoid conversion dwell and unrelated submission metadata, while requiring a separate authenticated status read before delivery can be displayed.

A terminal result requires the exact account, fax, outbound direction and destination. Positive complete page counts and the documented result code are needed together; contradictory legacy error codes do not establish delivery or failure.

Shared by the SRFax team: provider setup must reject missing required or forbidden routing before an account can look ready. SRFax needs sender_email; Documo must not accept it. Documo additionally needs base or admin key access because print_driver cannot read delivery status.

Shared by the Spruce team: Spruce conversationItem.pages describes teammate paging, not fax pages. Keep provider-specific response interpretation; Documo pagesCount/pagesComplete cannot be generalized to every field named pages.

A lost submission response may follow provider acceptance. Retain the same durable operation and never send again automatically. Recover status with explicit bounded reads; retain failure evidence and verify it after reopening the database.
